titulo.es: Trump anuncia planes de inversión energética surcoreana por 200.000 millones de dólares
titulo.en: Trump administration diverts human rights funds to push far-right agenda abroad

sintesis.es: Trump anunció inversiones surcoreanas por 200.000 millones de dólares en energía de EEUU, incluidos 54.000 millones para un proyecto de GNL en Alaska que Seúl sostiene que aún no ha aceptado financiar.
sintesis.en: Support such as for white Afrikaners and anti-communism reveals how US is redefining what qualifies as human rights With hours left before the funding expires, the Trump administration is pushing to direct more than $175m of the state department’s flagship human rights fund to a slate of awards that includes a huge $40m grant for an anti-communism fund, support for a group advancing white Afrikaner rights in South Africa, a campaign against Brazil’s supreme court and programs that would reward ideological allies in Europe who protect “western civilizational norms”. On Wednesday, the state department obligated the funds to the grantees hours before the deadline despite congressional concerns and requests not to do so, according to a source familiar with the negotiations. The state department declined to comment on questions from the Guardian specifically on whether it had obligated the funds and had “blown” holds from Congress due to concerns about the money’s use.

titulo.es: Rusia amenaza a la OTAN con armas nucleares por Kaliningrado y Rutte pide calma
titulo.en: Russia threatens NATO with nuclear weapons over Kaliningrad, Rutte calls for calm

sintesis.es: Rusia envió una nota diplomática a la OTAN advirtiendo que usará 'todo su arsenal', incluidas armas nucleares, si la Alianza intenta aislar el enclave de Kaliningrado en el Báltico. La OTAN confirmó la advertencia y la calificó de 'retórica nuclear irresponsable', mientras su secretario general, Mark Rutte, pidió calma y aseguró que no existe una amenaza inmediata para la Alianza, aunque algunos líderes como el belga Theo Francken consideran a Rusia la mayor amenaza actual.
sintesis.en: Russia sent a diplomatic note to NATO warning it would use its 'entire arsenal', including nuclear weapons, if the Alliance attempts to isolate the Kaliningrad enclave in the Baltic Sea. NATO confirmed the warning and condemned it as 'irresponsible nuclear rhetoric', while Secretary-General Mark Rutte urged calm and stated there is no imminent threat to the Alliance, though some leaders like Belgium's Theo Francken view Russia as the greatest current threat.

titulo.es: ‘Explosion of melt rates’: 20% of Swiss glaciers lost in five years
titulo.en: ‘Explosion of melt rates’: 20% of Swiss glaciers lost in five years

sintesis.es: Alpine regions in Europe experiencing extreme glacier collapse due to heat-trapping effects of fossil fuel pollution Switzerland has lost almost one-fifth of its ice in just five years, research has found, in a dramatic reshaping of the Alpine country whose big white glaciers have been reduced to moonlike rock deserts, scientists say. Swiss glaciers shrank by 5.5% in the first eight months of 2026, according to an annual monitoring report, after a summer of scorching heatwaves that followed a winter with little snow. The reduction in ice volume falls just shy of the record set in 2022 and brings the total loss of glacier ice since 2021 to 19.4%.

titulo.es: Estados Unidos completa la retirada total de sus tropas de Irak tras 20 años
titulo.en: United States completes full troop withdrawal from Iraq after 20 years

sintesis.es: Estados Unidos finalizó el 30 de septiembre de 2026 la retirada completa de sus tropas de Irak, poniendo fin a una presencia militar iniciada en 2003 con la invasión que derrocó a Sadam Huseín y que posteriormente lideró la coalición contra el Estado Islámico. La decisión fue tomada por Joe Biden en 2024 y se concreta en un contexto regional tenso marcado por el conflicto entre Israel, Estados Unidos e Irán. La salida genera preocupación entre autoridades de la región kurda iraquí, especialmente por el retiro de los sistemas de defensa aérea estadounidenses.
sintesis.en: The United States completed the full withdrawal of its troops from Iraq on September 30, 2026, ending a military presence that began with the 2003 invasion that toppled Saddam Hussein and later led the coalition against the Islamic State. The decision was made by Joe Biden in 2024 and comes amid regional tensions linked to the conflict between Israel, the United States and Iran. The exit has raised concerns among Iraqi Kurdish authorities, particularly over the removal of US air defense systems.

titulo.es: Jueza aprueba fusión histórica de Paramount y Warner Bros. Discovery; Ynon Kreiz nombrado co-CEO
titulo.en: Judge approves historic Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger; Ynon Kreiz named co-CEO

sintesis.es: Una jueza federal estadounidense aprobó el acuerdo que permite la adquisición de Warner Bros. Discovery por Paramount, valorada en 110.000 millones de dólares, tras la impugnación de doce estados por motivos antimonopolio. El pacto incluye garantías de independencia editorial para CNN y la obligación de estrenar al menos 30 películas anuales durante dos años. Paralelamente, David Ellison nombró a Ynon Kreiz, ex CEO de Mattel, como co-CEO de la nueva compañía combinada.
sintesis.en: A US federal judge approved the settlement allowing Paramount's $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, after twelve states challenged the deal on antitrust grounds. The agreement includes editorial independence safeguards for CNN and requires the merged studio to release at least 30 films annually for two years. Separately, David Ellison named former Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz as co-CEO of the combined company.

titulo.es: Burnham reabre el debate del Brexit y propone posible reingreso del Reino Unido a la UE
titulo.en: Burnham reopens Brexit debate and floats possible UK rejoining of the EU

sintesis.es: El primer ministro británico Andy Burnham, en su estreno como jefe de Gobierno laborista, anunció en el congreso de su partido un paquete de reformas que incluye cambios al sistema electoral, medidas sobre vivienda y un acercamiento a la Unión Europea. Rompiendo un tabú político, planteó que su gobierno podría ir 'hasta el final' y evaluar la posibilidad de reingresar a la UE tras sopesar pros y contras de distintas opciones de relación. La UE respondió que corresponde a Londres definir el camino a seguir en sus futuras relaciones con el bloque.
sintesis.en: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, in his debut as Labour head of government, announced at his party's conference a package of reforms including changes to the electoral system, housing measures, and a rapprochement with the European Union. Breaking a political taboo, he suggested his government could go 'all the way' and consider rejoining the EU after weighing the pros and cons of different relationship options. The EU responded that it is up to London to chart its own path forward on future relations with the bloc.

titulo.es: Christa Pike sobrevive a dos inyecciones letales durante su ejecución en Tennessee
titulo.en: Christa Pike survives two lethal injection doses during her execution in Tennessee

sintesis.es: Christa Pike, condenada a muerte en Tennessee por un asesinato cometido en 1995, fue sometida a su ejecución luego de que la Corte Suprema de EE.UU. levantara una suspensión previa de un tribunal de apelaciones. Tras recibir dos dosis de inyección letal, Pike continuó con vida y fue trasladada a un hospital, lo que llevó a sus abogados a presentar una nueva moción para detener el procedimiento. El fallo provocó la suspensión de otra ejecución programada y la apertura de una investigación en el estado.
sintesis.en: Christa Pike, on death row in Tennessee for a 1995 murder, underwent her execution after the US Supreme Court lifted a prior stay from an appeals court. After receiving two doses of lethal injection, Pike remained alive and was transferred to a hospital, prompting her lawyers to file a new motion to halt the procedure. The failed execution led to the suspension of another scheduled execution and the opening of an investigation in the state.
